source_decision.summary: Within the scoped R208 candidate files (01, 02, 23), bounded A-to-B AST copying in source_input_bridge::from_program_bounded, the R100 draft preparation/admission seam in recursive_source::admit_checked_draft, preservation of legacy source_input_bridge::from_program for guarded scalar callers, and the owner-revision02 test import fix (use super::b;) are source-correct by static inspection. All ten SourceCopyBudget extents are checked with overflow-safe arithmetic before every affected Vec, Box, String, or worklist allocation, and shared Arc<a::Expr>/Arc<a::Tree> DAGs are metered per structural occurrence without pointer deduplication. All candidate code and unit tests remain SOURCE_ONLY and UNRUN.

integration_decision.summary: Internal seam integration between 01-candidate-source_input_bridge.rs, 02-candidate-recursive_source.rs, 16-B-shared-L622-L646.rs (OwnerEngine::admit/admit_run), 19-owner_host.rs (host_owner_engine/observe_bound_image), and 21-legacy-scalar-L66-L119.rs (prepare_scalar_action_host) is type- and signature-consistent in provided source. However, end-to-end config and diagnostic integration across provided basis files 08-basis-11-draft_contract.rs (R120) and 09-basis-12-draft_diagnostics.rs (R207) is incomplete in actual Rust source: (1) DraftPreprocessingExtents in 08 defines only 4 of the 10 copy extents and provides only parser_budget(self), while the 6 additional copy extents (max_copy_expr_nodes, max_copy_match_arms, max_copy_name_bytes, max_copy_list_elements, max_copy_tree_nodes, max_copy_tree_depth) and any SourceCopyBudget projection exist only as JSON proposals in 22; (2) draft_diagnostics in 09 projects only DraftError and DraftTypeError and has no JSON projection for SourceCopyError/SourceCopyBudgetExceeded/DraftSourceFailure::Copy. These gaps block R218 public/contract/diagnostic integration until implemented in Rust source.

mandatory_findings.assessment: All ten explicit copy extents in SourceCopyBudget (max_functions, max_parameters_per_function, max_total_parameters, max_expr_nodes, max_copy_depth, max_match_arms, max_name_bytes, max_list_elements, max_tree_nodes, max_tree_depth) have no Default impl and are enforced via check_limit and check_add (using usize::checked_add) prior to every corresponding heap allocation in from_program_bounded, copy_root_expression, value_bounded, and tree_bounded. Nullary Call expressions (input_args.is_empty()) do not falsely increment CopyDepth or ExprNodes. Traversal order (entry preorder then functions[0..N] preorder via LIFO worklist) matches legacy from_program.

Shared Arc<a::Expr> (ExprRef) and Arc<a::Tree> sub-DAGs in 04-basis-02-reference_types.rs are expanded into uniquely owned Box/Vec nodes in b::CoreProgram without pointer deduplication, charging ExprNodes, NameBytes, MatchArms, ListElements, and TreeNodes on every visited occurrence. On mid-copy budget failure, pending holds only borrows and drops cleanly while partially populated b::CoreProgram or b::CoreTree slots (initialized with leaf/bool placeholders expression_slot() and tree_slot()) are destroyed by the owner's iterative Drop in 05-basis-06-owner_prepare.rs. However, iterative Drop allocates transient worklist Vec<Box<CoreExpr>>/Vec<Box<CoreTree>> entries and replacement Box::new(dummy_expr())/Box::new(dummy_tree()) nodes on the heap (bounded in count by already-admitted nodes, not metered as fallible), and dropping the input Arc<a::Program> remains compiler-generated recursive Drop. This blocks any broader H1/process-memory/stack-byte claim.

In actual supplied Rust source, 08-basis-11-draft_contract.rs defines DraftPreprocessingExtents with only 10 total preprocessing fields (only max_functions, max_parameters_per_function, max_total_parameters, and max_copy_depth overlap with SourceCopyBudget) and only implements parser_budget(self). The six required copy-extent fields (max_copy_expr_nodes, max_copy_match_arms, max_copy_name_bytes, max_copy_list_elements, max_copy_tree_nodes, max_copy_tree_depth) and any copy_budget projection exist only in 22-AUTHOR-EXTENTS-MAPPING-GAPS.min.json. Likewise, 09-basis-12-draft_diagnostics.rs defines only source(DraftError) and types(DraftTypeError) and lacks a projection for SourceCopyError or DraftSourceFailure::Copy. This blocks downstream R218 contract/config/diagnostic source integration until 08 and 09 are updated in Rust source.

Legacy source_input_bridge::from_program in 01-candidate-source_input_bridge.rs (lines 774-964) is preserved byte-for-byte identical to 03-basis-01-source_input_bridge.rs (lines 22-212), maintaining compatibility with 21-legacy-scalar-L66-L119.rs (prepare_scalar_action_host), which enforces its own preflight/SourceHostBounds checks (17, 18, 20, 21) prior to calling from_program. On the R100 draft seam, 02-candidate-recursive_source.rs (admit_checked_draft) never calls unbounded from_program, requiring an explicit &SourceCopyBudget and forwarding the resulting CoreProgram to host_owner_engine().admit and admit_run with FinanceInput::Absent.

nonblocking_findings.assessment: Because SourceCopyBudgetExceeded is Copy and zero-allocation, it records only function_index: Option<usize> and immediate parent-relative child_index: Option<usize> rather than a full Vec<usize> AST occurrence path (unlike LocatorC::Occurrence in 13-B-shared-L139-L140.rs or SourceLocation in 06-basis-08-draft_source.rs). For ListElements and root TreeDepth/TreeNodes inside value_bounded/tree_bounded, child_index is None. This is an intentional zero-allocation diagnostic trade-off and matches authored unit tests.

nonblocking_findings.assessment: DraftPreparationBudget in 02-candidate-recursive_source.rs bundles DraftParseBudget, max_type_depth, and SourceCopyBudget, but prepare_checked_draft and admit_checked_draft accept the split parameters directly rather than consuming DraftPreparationBudget. This is harmless in source but worth noting for future R218 caller wiring.

23-candidate-source_input_bridge_bounded_tests.rs repairs the parent alias import to use super::b; (resolving use super::shared as b; from 01 line 20) and provides 7 thorough unit tests for from_program_bounded, from_program, check_add, and check_limit across all 10 extents. However, all 7 tests are SOURCE_ONLY/UNRUN (never compiled or executed with cargo/rustc), and no unit tests in 23 exercise 02-candidate-recursive_source.rs (prepare_checked_draft / admit_checked_draft).

abstentions_and_gaps.detail: The six new R120 config fields and SourceCopyBudget projection described in 22-AUTHOR-EXTENTS-MAPPING-GAPS.min.json are not present in 08-basis-11-draft_contract.rs, and SourceCopyError diagnostic serialization is not present in 09-basis-12-draft_diagnostics.rs.

Only the iterative Drop excerpt of owner_prepare.rs (05) and public headers of draft_source.rs (06) and draft_typecheck.rs (07) are supplied. The implementations of Parser::program, mori_lexer::lex_with_token_limit, check_program_types_inner, owner_prepare::{prepare_core,check_program_view,admit,admit_run}, CheckedOwnerEngine::new_reviewed, PreImage::bind, implied_seg_base, HostFamilyPlans, and core_action_consumer_security::{preflight_source,check_generated,check_combined_generated_ast_nodes} are outside the supplied source closure.

Iterative Drop in 05-basis-06-owner_prepare.rs avoids native stack recursion for b::CoreProgram/CoreExpr/CoreTree but allocates transient worklist Vecs and replacement dummy boxes on the heap; input a::Program/a::Expr/a::Tree uses Arc with recursive Drop. Neither numerical copy caps/defaults nor global host heap, stack-byte, or wall-clock time admission (H1) are established here.

All 23 supplied bodies are inspected statically in isolation without rustc/cargo typechecking or test execution. Module registration in lib.rs/mod.rs and R218 public compile route integration remain outside this review.
